test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Six boxes of different food items are kept in a row on the dining table. The box with toffees is kept at one end. There are three boxes kept between the box with toffees and the box with chocolates. The box with ice cream is not kept with the toffee box or the fruit-jam box. Cookies and pancakes boxes are kept with the ice cream box. Which of the following box is kept at an end?
solution:
As per the given information: 

**Step 1:** The box with toffees is kept at one end. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0776f720e3b171dc4706ce9581df9a04027fea26fbd7441086e41fa6f8bd16f.png] 

**Step 2:** There are three boxes kept between the box with toffees and the box with chocolates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/288bb9f2b412fd6d83e7f4208ace3eb7d53ecc6ec7ed5333727bef8e6ab875b6.png] 

**Step 3:** Cookies and pancakes boxes are kept with the ice cream box. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1855d65cd7c96abff7661c8e12b68b7dbb7bd391dd81731bf783b23838b008c.png] 

**Step 4:** The box with ice cream is not kept with the toffee box or the fruit jam box. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe7ae8b34a5120ae673e80d18fb00f00b6f786ef9bff9cc9d7e6a911c0c06e71.png] 

From the arrangement we can see that, **fruit jam will be placed at the other end.**

Hence the correct answer is **Option 2.**
